About.label: About
About.title: About Me
About.description: After shipping commercial products reaching 100k+ users and building a foundation in high-performance web systems and AI-native architecture, I've shifted my focus toward engineering growth.
About.bio1: For me, that means more than just writing code — spotting technical opportunities, optimizing for sub-second latency, and making bold architectural decisions that survive real-world scale.
About.bio2: I believe great software is a team sport. I thrive in environments where we ship quickly, challenge each other's ideas, and celebrate wins together. Whether it's mentoring interns or collaborating with cross-functional teams, my goal is always the same: building scalable platforms that don't just work, but excel.

items.0: AI & Voice Advisory App (Tech Lead): Architected a React Native & Nest.js platform. Enabled voice consultations and AI advice via OpenAI with custom prompting pipelines.
items.1: Creative Design Platform: Engineered a headless video rendering engine using Puppeteer, Express, and Nginx for server-side React animation rendering.
items.2: Helped evolve the platform from no-code constraints to a scalable cloud-based architecture supporting 70,000+ users.Engineered core monetization systems including internal wallet infrastructure, Stripe & PayPal integrations, payout automation logic, backend services, analytics pipelines, and AI-driven internal tools.
items.3: Video Course Platform: Handled 2,000+ users and 700+ paid subscriptions in 6 hours using optimized DB indexing and caching.
items.4: E-commerce Migration: Migrated React to Next.js. Improved LCP/CLS by 40% and reduced hosting costs by 17%.
items.5: Technical Leadership: Standardized CI/CD pipelines, linting rules, and reusable templates across projects.

8.description: Safe place for children. High-security educational gaming. Bridging React Native with Unity modules and implementing RAG for intelligent in-game interactions. Built custom editors and live chat under strict child privacy standards.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance
sections.body: By accessing this portfolio website (yaroslavdolhushyn.dev), you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. These terms apply alongside the Privacy Policy, which is incorporated by reference.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of the Site
sections.body: This website is a personal portfolio showcasing the professional work, skills, and background of Yaroslav Dolhushyn. It is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute a commercial offering, employment contract, or binding professional engagement.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics & Session Recording
sections.body:
This site uses Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use the site. These tools may collect anonymised usage data including page views, session duration, clicks, and screen recordings. They are only activated after your explicit consent via the cookie banner.

For full details on what is collected and how, see the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 4. AI-Powered Features
sections.body:
This site includes experimental AI features:

• AI Chat — answers questions about Yaroslav's background using a language model. Responses are generated automatically and may not always be accurate or complete.
• Voice Chat — allows spoken interaction with the AI assistant. Audio is processed by third-party APIs (Groq, ElevenLabs) and is not stored.

These features are provided "as is" for demonstration purposes. Do not rely on AI-generated responses as professional or legal advice. The operator makes no guarantees regarding accuracy, availability, or fitness for a particular purpose.

sections.body:
All content on this site — including text, design, code, and media — is the property of Yaroslav Dolhushyn unless otherwise stated. You may not reproduce, redistribute, or use any content commercially without prior written permission.

Project descriptions and experience information represent Yaroslav's own contributions to past professional engagements and do not reveal confidential client information.

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the operator shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of this website or its AI features, including but not limited to reliance on AI-generated content.

sections.heading: 2. Contact Form
sections.body:
When you submit the contact form, we collect your name, email address, and message. This data is transmitted directly to the controller's email address and is used solely to respond to your inquiry.

Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a pre-contractual measure at the data subject's request). Data is retained only as long as needed to handle your inquiry and is then deleted.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics — Google Analytics 4
sections.body:
This website uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4), a web analytics service provided by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. GA4 collects anonymised usage data (pages visited, session duration, device type, approximate location based on IP) to help understand how visitors interact with the site.

GA4 is only loaded after you have given your explicit consent via the cookie banner.

Legal basis: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent). You may withdraw consent at any time by clearing the cookie-consent entry in your browser's local storage.

Data may be transferred to Google LLC servers in the United States under standard contractual clauses. For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: 4. Session Recording & Heatmaps — Microsoft Clarity
sections.body:
This website uses Microsoft Clarity, a session analytics service provided by Microsoft Corporation, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, WA 98052, USA. Clarity records anonymised user sessions including mouse movements, clicks, scrolls, and heatmaps to help understand how visitors interact with the site. Clarity may capture the content visible on screen during a session.

Microsoft Clarity is only loaded after you have given your explicit consent via the cookie banner.

Legal basis: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent). You may withdraw consent at any time by clearing the cookie-consent entry in your browser's local storage.

Data may be transferred to Microsoft servers in the United States under standard contractual clauses. For more information, see Microsoft's Privacy Statement at https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement.

sections.heading: 5. AI Chat
sections.body:
The portfolio includes an AI-powered chat assistant. Messages you send are transmitted to the OpenAI API (OpenAI, L.L.C., San Francisco, USA) to generate a response. Messages are processed in real time and are not stored on our servers beyond the active browser session.

Legal basis: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in providing an interactive portfolio experience). Data is not used to train AI models.

For more information, see OpenAI's Privacy Policy at https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy.

sections.heading: 6. Voice Chat
sections.body:
The portfolio includes an optional voice chat feature. When you use it:

• Your microphone audio is recorded locally in your browser and sent to Groq, Inc. (USA) for speech-to-text transcription.
• The transcribed text is sent to Groq's LLM API to generate a response.
• Optionally, the text response is converted to speech via ElevenLabs, Inc. (USA).

Audio recordings and transcripts are not stored on our servers. Processing is transient and used only to generate the reply.

Legal basis: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (your explicit action of activating the microphone constitutes consent). You may stop voice processing at any time by closing the voice widget.

For more information, see:
• Groq Privacy Policy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/
• ElevenLabs Privacy Policy: https://elevenlabs.io/privacy

sections.heading: 7. Cookies & Local Storage
sections.body:
This website uses browser local storage (not cookies) to remember your cookie consent preference. No tracking cookies are placed without your consent.

If you accept analytics cookies, the following third-party cookies may be set:
• Google Analytics 4: __ga, __ga_* (session/user distinction)
• Microsoft Clarity: _clsk, _clck (session recording)

You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing your browser's local storage for this domain.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
sections.body:
Under GDPR, you have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you (Art. 15)
• Rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16)
• Erasure of your data ("right to be forgotten") (Art. 17)
• Restriction of processing (Art. 18)
• Data portability (Art. 20)
• Object to processing (Art. 21)
• Withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing (Art. 7(3))

To exercise any of these rights, please contact: yardolhushyn@gmail.com

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. In Germany, this is the relevant Landesbeauftragter für den Datenschutz.

sections.heading: 9. Data Security
sections.body: This website is served over HTTPS. We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, or unauthorised disclosure.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
